King Charles to Address 'Darkest Days' on Caribbean Tour

King Charles III will not offer an apology for slavery during his upcoming tour of the Caribbean. The tour will, however, address "the darkest days of our past," according to reports. The King's stance on not apologizing for slavery has been noted.
